mentions.h: Bels fight for third place at Sportcity
British Athletics League Premiership: League team on the ropes

photos.c: Above: BAL Match 2 at Sportcity, Manchester, and back into the team after an absence of a year or so was Paskar Owor. He ran to second place in the 800m but has his eyes set on a 1500m slot at Osaka in the the IAAF World Champs where he hopes to represent Uganda.
